column1: Ulbe Bosma's The World of Sugar is a genuinely global history.
column2: 乌尔贝·博斯马的《糖的世界》是一部真正的全球史。

column1: Bosma discusses all the sugar-growing places of the world, beginning with Cuba and Java, the largest exporters of the early 20th century.
column2: 博斯马从古巴和爪哇这两个20世纪初最大的糖出口地谈起，论及世界上所有种植糖料作物的地区。

column1: But this is a history not just of cane sugar but also of beet sugar, an equally important form of traded sugar over the last hundred years.
column2: 但这部书写的不只是甘蔗糖的历史，还写了甜菜糖：在过去一百年的糖贸易中，甜菜糖同样举足轻重。
column8: over the last hundred years|在过去一百年间

column1: Beet sugar is grown mainly in Europe and the United States.
column2: 用来制糖的甜菜主要种植在欧洲和美国。

column1: It has also been massively subsidised and sold at artificially low prices on world markets, threatening the livelihood of producers of cane sugar.
column2: 甜菜糖还获得了巨额补贴，在世界市场上以人为压低的价格出售，威胁着甘蔗糖生产者的生计。
column5: artificially low prices|人为压低的价格

column1: Bosma's discussion of the sugar market in Britain gives a sense of the book's range.
column2: 从博斯马对英国糖市场的论述，便能看出这本书涉及的范围有多广。
column5: gives a sense of|使人对……有所了解

column1: The sweet-toothed British first bought cane sugar from their own slavery-dependent colonial plantations.
column2: 嗜甜的英国人最初从自己那些依赖奴隶制度的殖民地种植园购买甘蔗糖。

column1: Following the abolition of slavery in the British Empire, cane sugar was imported to Britain from places which retained the practice, such as Cuba and Brazil.
column2: 大英帝国废除奴隶制之后，英国转而从古巴、巴西等仍保留奴隶制的地区进口甘蔗糖。

column1: Towards the end of the 19th century, the British started to import beet sugar from continental Europe.
column2: 临近19世纪末，英国人开始从欧洲大陆进口甜菜糖。
column3: Towards the end of|临近……末期

column1: Only in the 20th century was there a move to develop a national beet sugar industry.
column2: 直到20世纪，英国才开始着手发展本国的甜菜糖产业。
column4: a move to|采取措施去做

column1: The book provides a global labour history, investigating the wide range of labour regimes associated with growing sugar.
column2: 这部书也呈现了一部全球劳工史，考察了与糖料作物种植相关的形形色色的劳动制度。

column1: Contrary to popular belief, cane sugar production was never just restricted to large, dedicated plantations owned by rich men.
column2: 与人们通常的想法相反，甘蔗糖生产从来没有仅限于富人拥有的、专门种植甘蔗的大型种植园。

column1: For example, in Java, a huge exporter of sugar in the early 20th century, sugar cane was grown together with rice in an extraordinarily labour-intensive way by small farmers.
column2: 比如，在20世纪初的糖出口大户爪哇，小农户将甘蔗与水稻一同种植，这种种植方式需要投入极其大量的人力。

column1: The World of Sugar is also a story of similarity and continuity in sugar cultivation.
column2: 《糖的世界》也写出了各地糖料作物种植的相似之处，以及不同时代之间的延续性。

column1: For example, imported labour has been used for much large-scale production.
column2: 例如，大规模生产有很大一部分都使用了从外地引入的劳工。

column1: German beet fields employed Polish workers; Mexicans and many others, including Sicilians, were vital to US sugar production.
column2: 德国的甜菜田雇用波兰工人；而墨西哥人和其他许多地方的人，包括西西里人，对美国的糖生产至关重要。

column1: Cane cutting, Bosma shows, remains a poorly paid and brutal business to this day in many places in the world.
column2: 博斯马指出，直到今天，在世界许多地方，砍甘蔗仍是一项报酬低微、极其艰苦的工作。

column1: But as well as this, the book is about the continuity of the use of traditional methods on small farms.
column2: 此外，书中还讲到，小型农场一直沿用着传统方法。
column3: as well as this|除此之外

column1: In the mid 20th-century, this type of sugar production dominated in South Asia and Latin America.
column2: 20世纪中叶，这种糖生产方式在南亚和拉丁美洲占据主导地位。

column1: This is also a history of capitalists and sugar dynasties, as well as corporations that in some cases have remained influential over very long periods.
column2: 这也是一部资本家、制糖家族和企业的历史，有些企业在很长的时期内始终具有影响力。
column4: sugar dynasties|世代经营糖业的家族
column6: in some cases|在某些情况下

column1: Great firms and great interests have had profound influence on the policies of states.
column2: 大型企业和强大的利益集团对各国政策产生了深远影响。

column1: In many places – not just the British Caribbean but Cuba and the Philippines too – a powerful sugar bourgeoisie played a major role in politics and their interests were consequently protected by trade barriers and subsidies.
column2: 在不少地区，不只是英属加勒比地区，还有古巴和菲律宾，强大的糖业资产阶级都在政治中发挥了重要作用，因此他们的利益受到了贸易壁垒和补贴的保护。
column6: played a major role in|在……中发挥重要作用

column1: In the battle for control of the industry, it was inevitably the poor countries which came off worse.
column2: 在争夺糖业控制权的斗争中，处于下风的难免是那些贫穷国家。
column7: came off worse|处于下风；吃亏

column1: All this is explored by Bosma with wonderful subtlety and control.
column2: 博斯马对这一切的探讨细致入微，叙述也拿捏得恰到好处。

column1: But sugar production was never just a matter of agriculture.
column2: 然而，制糖从来都不只是农业的事。

column1: It also involved the extraction, close to the place of harvest, of sucrose from the sugar plant, a process which required machinery powered by humans, animals, wind or steam.
column2: 制糖还涉及在收获地附近从糖料作物中提取蔗糖，这个过程要用到靠人力、畜力、风力或蒸汽驱动的机械。

column1: Further processes involved boiling (from the 19th century, this often involved vacuum systems) and the separation of sugar from other materials in a process known as refinement.
column2: 后续工序包括煮糖（从19世纪起，这一步常会用到真空设备），以及将糖同其他物质分离，后一过程称为精炼。

column1: From very early on, sugar production was an energy-intensive industrial process, mostly taking place in the countryside and in refineries in centres of consumption, both small and large.
column2: 早在初期，制糖就是一项高耗能的工业生产，主要在农村以及大小消费中心的炼糖厂进行。
column3: From very early on|早在初期
column8: refineries|n. 精炼厂；此指炼糖厂

column1: The growth of the industry entailed a very rapid diffusion of ideas and techniques from one country to another.
column2: 糖业的发展伴随着思想和技术从一国向另一国的迅速传播。

column1: Cuba, for example, developed an extraordinarily dense system of railways to transport workers and cane, as well as steam-powered sugar factories.
column2: 例如，古巴修建了异常密集的铁路网来运送工人和甘蔗，还建起了以蒸汽为动力的糖厂。

column1: Particular varieties of cane sugar and beet sugar spread very rapidly across the world, in accordance with local needs and demands.
column2: 一些品种的甘蔗糖和甜菜糖很快就传遍了世界，适应了各地的需要与需求。

column1: Where once only tiny quantities of sugar could be produced, now new techniques, varieties, fertilisers, irrigation systems and much more have turned gleaming white sugar into a ubiquitous chemical.
column2: 过去只能生产出很少的糖，如今新技术、新品种、新型肥料和灌溉系统等种种进步，使晶莹洁白的糖成了一种无处不在的化学物质。

column1: Over the same time, there has been a massive increase in consumption.
column2: 在此期间，糖的消费量也大幅增加。
column3: Over the same time|在同一时期

column1: Once regarded as a luxury, sugar came to be promoted as a valuable source of energy.
column2: 糖曾被视为奢侈品，后来却被大力宣传为一种宝贵的能量来源。

column1: But as the consumption of sugar has increased, so has the harm it does, whether to people's teeth or weight.
column2: 但随着糖消费量的增加，它造成的伤害也在加重，不论是对牙齿还是对体重的影响。

column1: In the face of appalling obstruction from the sugar industry to attempts to reduce consumption, some countries have been forced to tax sugar in order to bring that about.
column2: 面对糖业界对减少糖消费的努力所作的严重阻挠，一些国家不得不向糖征税，以达到减糖的目的。

column1: The sugar industry has a history of attacking its critics and, when it comes to obesity, of trying to blame fats, and lack of exercise and self-control.
column2: 糖业界一向会攻击批评者；一谈到肥胖问题，就试图把责任归咎于脂肪、缺乏运动和缺乏自制力。
column3: has a history of|一向有……的做法

column1: And the recent past has seen worrying new developments in mass sweetening.
column2: 而近些年，大规模使用甜味剂也出现了令人担忧的新动向。

column1: High-fructose corn syrup made from maize using an enzymatic process invented in Japan in the 1960s has a similar number of calories to table sugar but is far cheaper to produce.
column2: 高果糖玉米糖浆以玉米为原料，采用的是20世纪60年代在日本发明的酶法工艺；它所含的热量与食糖相近，生产成本却低得多。
column3: High-fructose corn syrup|高果糖玉米糖浆

column1: It is now widely consumed, having been adopted in the making of soft drinks and a large number of processed foods, and is regarded as a leading cause of obesity.
column2: 它如今被广泛食用，软饮料和许多加工食品都已经用上了它；人们认为，它是导致肥胖的主要原因之一。

column1: This is a wonderfully rich book, a model of global history, the history of production and the history of capitalism.
column2: 这是一本内容极为丰富的书，堪称全球史、生产史和资本主义史写作的典范。

column1: Bosma avoids outbursts of emotion, celebratory or critical, even if they might have made his analysis of the multiple tragedies involving sugar all the more powerful.
column2: 博斯马没有任由情绪宣泄，无论是赞颂还是批判；即使那样做或许会使他对糖所牵涉的种种悲剧的分析更有力量，他也保持了克制。

column1: He shows that we could always have done without sugar and that today we have many alternative sources of sweetness.
column2: 他表明，人类其实一直都可以没有糖，而如今我们也有许多其他获取甜味的途径。
column3: could always have done without|本来一直可以没有

column1: Yet many of the poorest people in the world still depend on it to make a living.
column2: 然而，世界上仍有许多极贫困的人依靠糖谋生。
